message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libbpf && python3 - <<'PY'
import struct, os
# create minimal ELF64 little-endian with two sections .BTF and .BTF.ext
BTF_MAGIC=0xeB9F; BTF_VERSION=1
btf=struct.pack('<HBBIIIIII', BTF_MAGIC, BTF_VERSION, 0, 24, 0, 4, 4, 4, 0)+b'\x00\x00\x00\x00'
ext=struct.pack('<HBBIIIIII', BTF_MAGIC, BTF_VERSION, 0, 32, 0,0, 0,0, 0)+struct.pack('<I',8)+struct.pack('<II',0,1)
shstr=b'\x00.BTF\x00.BTF.ext\x00.shstrtab\x00'
off_btf=1; off_ext=6; off_shstr=15
# layout
elf_header_size=64
shoff=elf_header_size+len(btf)+len(ext)+len(shstr)
# section headers: null, BTF, BTF.ext, shstrtab
shentsize=64; shnum=4; shstrndx=3
# build ELF header
E=bytearray(elf_header_size)
E[0:16]=b'\x7fELF'+bytes([2,1,1])+bytes(9)
struct.pack_into('<HHIQQQIHHHHHH',E,16,1,62,1,0,0,shoff,0,64,0,0,shentsize,shnum,shstrndx)
# section headers
sh=bytearray(shentsize*shnum)
# null already zero
# .BTF
struct.pack_into('<IIQQQQIIQQ',sh,64,off_btf,1,0,0,elf_header_size,len(btf),0,0,4,0)
# .BTF.ext
struct.pack_into('<IIQQQQIIQQ',sh,128,off_ext,1,0,0,elf_header_size+len(btf),len(ext),0,0,4,0)
# shstrtab
struct.pack_into('<IIQQQQIIQQ',sh,192,off_shstr,3,0,0,elf_header_size+len(btf)+len(ext),len(shstr),0,0,1,0)
blob=bytes(E)+btf+ext+shstr+bytes(sh)
open('/tmp/test.o','wb').write(blob)
print('size',len(blob))
PY
cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libbpf && ./bpf-object-fuzzer /tmp/test.o >/tmp/out 2>&1; ec=$?; echo EXIT:$ec; head -50 /tmp/out` executed with exit code 0.
